service.description: Apply each configured telemetry retention independently. A failed index is logged and the remaining indexes continue.

With search-facade postgres partition-telemetry="true", move each telemetry table made before it was on (or only index) into a day-partitioned table: rows are copied a day at a time, then the new table is swapped in under a short lock. The old table is kept as <table>_unpartitioned to drop. A failed table is logged and listed, and the others go on.

parameter.name: index
parameter.description: otel_spans, otel_logs, otel_metrics or monitor_annotations; empty is all.

service.description: Roll minute metrics into hours and hours into days, with deterministic document ids for safe retries.
Scrape each enabled moqui.monitor.ScrapeTarget whose interval has passed into otel_metrics, or targetId now. A failed target is logged and recorded on its row, and the others are still scraped.

Run each enabled moqui.monitor.SyntheticCheck whose interval has passed, or checkId now. Each is a root span (moqui.synthetic.check) kept whatever the sample ratio; a failed check is an error span, logged, and recorded on its row.
